newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixes quietly just easier.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixes quietly just easier.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed at 472.25 cents vs 476.00 cents previously. Attracting little interest.
GOLD - Steady around $345.00/$345.50, just firmer and nearing top of recent range. Helped by PGMs
PLATINUM - Up $13.50 at $410.00/$414.00 despite end to Rustenburg strike. Very tight, market nervous.
PALLADIUM - Down about $8.00 at $188.00/$192.00. Also tight.
